title: AdCP Async Response Data
description: Validation union of supported async webhook payloads. For completed/failed statuses, use the main task response schema. For rejected get_products outcomes and working/input-required/submitted statuses, use the status-specific schemas. Because this shared webhook union is not tagged with the originating task type, callers MUST also validate a terminal result against that task or event's specific schema. Polling responses use a generic result selected through manifest.task_result_resolution instead of embedding this union.
